$comment: Checked topic registry for the CANON-C source-link contract. source-required topics are one per (emitted owner, rendered exact-file link) pair; their topicId is derived as <ownerSlug>:<targetKey> and re-derived by the validator. retained-normative-snippet topics name a rule that survives in prose; evidence is a literal substring the owner must still contain. The derived source-link inventory must assert that its topic set equals this registry exactly; this file is a contract, not a second authority.
